name: oncue
description: Explainer Shorts where every word lands on cue. Storyboard a topic into beats, record an ElevenLabs voiceover with word timestamps, and render a native PowerPoint deck and an animated MP4 in which every element enters on the word that names it: vertical 9:16 for Shorts, Reels and TikTok, widescreen 16:9 for YouTube, or a custom size. One short.json spec drives the deck, the script and the video.
